art_direction: 成年贝吉塔穿深蓝高领便服，靠在简约城市栏杆，侧脸与暮蓝天际利落干净。
composition_variation: Create a sleek minimalist anime portrait of adult Vegeta standing on a quiet modern pedestrian terrace. Preserve his iconic upright black hair, strong widow's peak, sharp dark eyes, and serious adult expression. Dress him in a fully covering navy high-neck sweater, charcoal tailored trousers, and dark shoes. He rests one elbow lightly against a wide stone railing while looking sideways toward the skyline. Use navy, graphite, silver, and one muted cobalt accent, with restrained evening rim light and expansive calm sky. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
